title: Design: Customers list shows the Internal badge after the customer name
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a customer flagged as Internal customer.
  • Open the attached pictures iwo-flow0-10-04-customers-list.png, iwo-happy-07-07-customers-list.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The flagged customer's row shows a small "Internal" badge right after its name; no other row has one.
  • The badge is orange text on a light orange background, the same badge used on work orders (see the picture).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11758 (Story 1, Turn on Internal Work Orders, flag internal customers, manage categories)

  • S1-R8: “While the setting is on, a flagged customer shows an "Internal" badge next to its name in the customer header, in the customers list and on the customers list mobile card. While the setting is off the badge is hidden in all three places (S1-N4); the badges on work orders stay (S2-R10).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
